info.title: InCites Document Level Metrics API
info.description: The InCites API provides document level metrics from InCites to support integration with Institutional Repository (IR) and Current Research Information Systems (CRIS). Ask your account manager about subscribing to the InCites API, or contact our support team to let us know you are interested.

tags.name: InCites Metrics API
tags.description:
Provides document-level metrics from InCites for integration with Institutional Repositories (IR)
and Current Research Information Systems (CRIS).

Append `/json` or `/xml` to each endpoint path to select the response format.

post.summary: Get document-level metrics by UT for WOS (POST)
post.description:
POST variant of `DocumentLevelMetricsByUT` for use with Web of Science integrations.
Accepts a JSON body with a list of UTs — up to 5000 per request.

This endpoint is useful when submitting more UTs than a query string can handle,
or when integrating with WOS-based workflows.

**Request body structure:**
```json
{
  "UT": ["000352040700014", "000614520100001", "000353267900023"],
  "esci": "y",
  "schema": "wos"
}
```

**Example — JSON:**
```
POST /DocumentLevelMetricsByUTforWOS/json
Content-Type: application/json

{"UT":["000352040700014","000614520100001"],"esci":"y","schema":"wos"}
```

**Example — XML:**
```
POST /DocumentLevelMetricsByUTforWOS/xml
Content-Type: application/json

{"UT":["000352040700014","000614520100001"],"esci":"y","schema":"wos"}
```

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: `json` or `xml`

parameters.name: X-ApiKey
parameters.description: Developer key parameter, authenticates you to use the service and ties your institution id to the call.

requestBody.description:
JSON payload containing the list of UTs and optional parameters.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `UT` | string[] | Yes | List of 15-character UT accession numbers |
| `esci` | string | No | Include ESCI content: `y` or `n` |
| `schema` | string | No | Classification schema (e.g. `wos`, `esi`, `for1`). Defaults to `wos`. |

**Maximum UTs per request:** 5000

get.summary: Get document-level metrics by UT (Unique Tag / accession number)
get.description:
Returns InCites document-level metrics for up to 100 publication UTs per request.

A **UT (Unique Tag)** is a 15-character alphanumeric accession number used in Web of Science.
All trailing zeros must be retained. UTs are comma-delimited.

**Sample UTs you can use for testing:**
- `000352040700014`
- `000614520100001`
- `000353267900023`
- `000346982900018`
- `000346342200004`

**Example — JSON:**
```
GET /DocumentLevelMetricsByUT/json?UT=000352040700014,000614520100001&esci=y&ver=2&schema=wos
```

**Example — XML:**
```
GET /DocumentLevelMetricsByUT/xml?UT=000352040700014,000614520100001&esci=y&ver=2&schema=wos
```

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: `json` or `xml`

parameters.name: UT
parameters.description:
Comma-delimited list of UT accession numbers. A canonical UT is 15 alphanumeric characters
with all trailing zeros retained. Values of any shape are accepted and forwarded to InCites,
which decides what exists; unknown UTs simply return no metrics.
A maximum of 100 UTs may be submitted per request, unless a higher limit is attached to
your developer key.

Sample UTs: `000352040700014,000614520100001,000353267900023,000346982900018,000346342200004`

parameters.name: esci
parameters.description: Include ESCI content. `y` = include, `n` = exclude.

parameters.name: ver
parameters.description: API version. Always use `2`.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Classification schema. See DocumentLevelMetricsByInstitutionId for the full list of valid values. Defaults to `wos`.

parameters.name: X-ApiKey
parameters.description: Developer key parameter, authenticates you to use the service and ties your institution id to the call.

XML response.value:
<response xmlns="http://www.isinet.com/xrpc42">
  <fn name="IncitesWebServices.getDocumentLevelMetricsByUT" rc="OK">
    <list>
      <map>
        <val name="ACCESSION_NUMBER">000352040700014</val>
        <val name="DOCUMENT_TYPE">ARTICLE</val>
        <val name="TIMES_CITED">42</val>
        <list name="PERCENTILE">
          <map>
            <val name="SUBJECT">Biochemistry & Molecular Biology</val>
            <val name="CATPERCENTILE">67.8</val>
          </map>
        </list>
      </map>
    </list>
  </fn>
</response>

value.message: UT value cannot be null or empty

get.summary: Get total record count by Institution ID and year
get.description:
Returns the total number of publications linked to your institution for the given year.
Use this endpoint **before** calling `DocumentLevelMetricsByInstitutionId` to determine
how many pages of results exist.

The institution this call is scoped to is resolved from your `X-ApiKey` — there is no
institution parameter to supply.

**Example:**
```
GET /DocumentLevelMetricsByInstitutionIdRecordCount/json?year=2020
```

parameters.description: Response format: `json` or `xml`

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Publication year. Must be 1980 or later.

parameters.name: X-ApiKey

get.summary: Get document-level metrics by Institution ID
get.description:
Returns document-level metrics (citations, NCI, percentile, etc.) for all publications
linked to the given institution in a specific year.

Use `DocumentLevelMetricsByInstitutionIdRecordCount` first to determine the total number
of records, then paginate through with `startingrecord` and `recordcount`.

The institution this call is scoped to is resolved from your `X-ApiKey` — there is no
institution parameter to supply.

**Example — JSON:**
```
GET /DocumentLevelMetricsByInstitutionId/json?year=2020&recordcount=5&startingrecord=1&ver=2&schema=wos&esci=y
```

**Example — XML:**
```
GET /DocumentLevelMetricsByInstitutionId/xml?year=2020&recordcount=5&startingrecord=1&ver=2&schema=wos&esci=y
```

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: `json` or `xml`

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Publication year to filter results. Must be 1980 or later.

parameters.name: startingrecord
parameters.description: Pagination: index of the first record to return. Starts at 1.

parameters.name: recordcount
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return per request. Must be between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: esci
parameters.description: Include ESCI (Emerging Sources Citation Index) content. `y` = include, `n` = exclude.

parameters.name: ver
parameters.description: API version. Always use `2`.

| `for1` | Fields of Research Level 1 |
| `for2` | Fields of Research Level 2 |
| `scadcl1` | SCADC Level 1 |
| `scadcl2` | SCADC Level 2 |
| `ref2008` | REF 2008 |
| `ref2014` | REF 2014 |
| `ref2021` | REF 2021 |
| `ct` | Citation Topics |
| `et` | Emerging Topics |
| `sdg` | Sustainable Development Goals |
| `gras` | GRAS |
| `anvur` | ANVUR (Italy) |
| `esi` | Essential Science Indicators |
| `fapesp` | FAPESP (Brazil) |
| `gipp` | GIPP |
| `kakenl2` | KAKENHI Level 2 |
| `kakenl3` | KAKENHI Level 3 |
| `oecd` | OECD |
| `pl19` | Polish Classification 2019 |
| `ris3` | RIS3 |

get.summary: Check UTs and return the ones InCites does not recognise
get.description:
Submits a comma-delimited list of UTs and returns **only the UTs that are not valid**
(not found in InCites). An **empty `rval` therefore means every submitted UT is valid** —
it is a successful result, not an error.

Backed by the MWS function `IncitesWebServices.getInvalidUTsList`, whose name is echoed
back in the `name` field of the response.

Use this to pre-filter UTs before calling the metrics endpoints. This endpoint returns
no metrics.

**Example — JSON (one valid UT, one bogus UT):**
```
GET /CheckValidUTs/json?UT=000352040700014,ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ
```

**Example — XML:**
```
GET /CheckValidUTs/xml?UT=000352040700014,ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ
```

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: `json` or `xml`

parameters.name: UT
parameters.description:
Comma-delimited list of UT accession numbers to check. A canonical UT is 15 alphanumeric
characters, but values of any shape are accepted and forwarded to InCites, which decides
what is valid. Up to 100 UTs per request, unless a higher limit is attached to your
developer key.

Sample: `000352040700014,000614520100001,ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ`

parameters.name: X-ApiKey
parameters.description: Developer key parameter, authenticates you to use the service and ties your institution id to the call.

200.description: Success — returns the invalid UTs (empty when all are valid)

Record.description:
A single publication record with InCites document-level metrics.
Returned by DocumentLevelMetricsByUT and DocumentLevelMetricsByInstitutionId.

ACCESSION_NUMBER.description: Web of Science accession number (UT) — 15 alphanumeric characters

TIMES_CITED.description: Total citation count from Web of Science

JOURNAL_EXPECTED_CITATIONS.description: Expected citations for the journal in this publication year

IMPACT_FACTOR.description: Journal Impact Factor for the publication year

HARMEAN_CAT_EXP_CITATION.description: Harmonic mean of category expected citations

ESI_HIGHLY_CITED_PAPER.description: 1 if ESI Highly Cited Paper, 0 otherwise

IS_INTERNATIONAL_COLLAB.description: 1 if the paper has international co-authors, 0 otherwise

IS_INSTITUTION_COLLAB.description: 1 if the paper has co-authors from other institutions, 0 otherwise

IS_INDUSTRY_COLLAB.description: 1 if the paper has industry co-authors, 0 otherwise

RNUM.description: Record sequence number (1-based) within the result set

PERCENTILE.description: List of category-level percentile data. One entry per subject category.

Percentile.description: Subject category percentile data for a publication

SUBJECT.description: Name of the Web of Science subject category

CODE.description: Short code for the subject category

CATPERCENTILE.description: Percentile rank within the subject category (0–100; higher is better)

IS_BEST.description: 1 if this is the best (highest) percentile category for the paper
